commonStyle: Art direction for an original tabletop RPG manual: pen and ink editorial illustration with clear irregular contour lines, selective crosshatching, broad flat shapes and uncoated ivory paper visible. Three inks only: charcoal black, desaturated slate blue, small accents of muted brick red. Confident economical drawing, mildly stylized believable people, ordinary specific clothing and practical objects, readable negative space. Asymmetric composition chosen for the scene. No imitation of a named artist. No lettering, no logos. No glossy digital painting, no photorealism, no 3D render, no cinematic lighting, no purple or gold glow, no bloom, no floating particles, no ornate decorative border. Texture must follow the drawn forms rather than being an overlay hiding errors. Anatomy, object function, perspective and visual storytelling must remain coherent.

editorialCandidates.name: capa-jogador-editorial
editorialCandidates.prompt: Portrait 2:3 cover artwork. Leave the upper 30 percent and bottom 12 percent mostly blank ivory paper for separately typeset title and credits. In the middle, three small travelers walk left to right across a simple uneven road, side view: a short stocky medieval traveler with a plain shield and rolled blanket; an older contemporary woman in a raincoat holding a closed notebook; a tall future explorer with a practical pressure helmet tucked under one arm. Distinct bodies, not perfect fashion models. A few footprints and one wind bent roadside plant. No vista collage, no portals, no arches, no magical effects. Convey different possible campaigns through the people, without a fixed setting. The main silhouette is low and horizontal, like a restrained illustrated book jacket.

editorialCandidates.name: capa-mestre-editorial
editorialCandidates.prompt: Portrait 2:3 cover artwork. Leave upper 30 percent and bottom 12 percent mostly blank ivory paper for separate typography. Middle area is an oblique overhead view of a small ordinary game table: one paper map with a river and simple buildings but NO writing, three mismatched wooden tokens, a blunt pencil, an eraser, a chipped mug, and a person's one hand moving a token. The map is a usable coherent place, not a magical miniature world. Carefully composed quiet still life, no glowing holograms, no city panoramas, no arches or planets, no dice with invented faces. Suggest the craft of preparing and conducting a game.

editorialCandidates.name: treino-memoria-editorial
editorialCandidates.prompt: Landscape 3:2 manual illustration. A novice adult woman wearing an ordinary white karate gi and white belt practices a basic punch, full body in side view. Her older instructor, shorter and stockier, points at her rear heel from a respectful distance. Two people, clearly separated limbs and plausible planted feet. A worn wooden dojo floor, a simple training pad resting against a wall, otherwise generous empty paper. Show concentration and learning, no combat spectacle. The basic technique is imperfect but recognizable: this is someone who still needs training, not a martial arts master.

editorialCandidates.name: investigacao-contemporanea-editorial
editorialCandidates.prompt: Landscape 3:2 manual illustration, ordinary contemporary setting. A middle aged woman in a creased practical raincoat crouches beside a drain to examine one small scrap of fabric snagged on its edge, with a compact flashlight aimed at the clue. A colleague remains partly concealed behind the doorway of a closed repair shop, watching the street. A few brick lines, a drain and a plain door establish the place. No rainy neon city panorama, no dramatic detective pose, no guns, no magic. Specific quiet investigation with readable hand positions, clue, flashlight beam and hiding place.

editorialCandidates.name: barreira-protecao-editorial
editorialCandidates.prompt: Landscape 3:2 fantasy manual illustration. A traveler in a plain patched tunic raises one hand to maintain a simple transparent curved magical barrier, shown as two restrained blue contour lines and a small interruption where ONE incoming stone hits. Behind the barrier, a second traveler supports an injured companion and retreats through a broken wall opening. Exactly three people, clear spatial relationship and believable grips. Barrier protects the retreat, no fireball, no exploding particles, no glowing runes. Minimal ruined stone setting, action readable in silhouette.

editorialCandidates.name: tripulacao-espacial-editorial
editorialCandidates.prompt: Landscape 3:2 science fiction manual illustration. A practical cramped spacecraft cockpit during a repair: foreground engineer kneels beside an open service panel, holding an insulated tool; seated pilot looks ahead with both hands on a simple control yoke; a third crew member points to one warning lamp on the panel. Exactly three people, clear readable hands and positions. Functional worn equipment, simple conduit routing, only a few unlabeled analog indicators, a small window containing a tiny planet. No holograms, no luminous UI walls, no glowing starfield spectacle, no arbitrary cables that go nowhere.

editorialCandidates.name: poder-unico-editorial
editorialCandidates.prompt: Landscape 3:2 conceptual manual illustration. On an ordinary rooftop with only a chimney and low parapet, a tired adult woman in a patched jacket clasps a small worn family keepsake at her chest. Her other open hand projects a single simple sheltering blue arc over two companions sheltering close together. Her expression and posture convey a stubborn personal determination to protect them. Exactly three figures, varied ordinary faces, clear separate arms. No giant gold web, no elaborate vortex, no glamour pose, no battle in background. The personal keepsake, gesture and protective relationship are the point of the image.

editorialCandidates.name: poder-ultimate-editorial
editorialCandidates.prompt: Landscape 3:2 conceptual manual illustration. An ordinary mortal in a plain long coat stands off center beside a broken public fountain, holding one palm up. Time is paused locally: five distinct water droplets hang above the basin and one fallen stone block hangs a few inches above the ground. A pigeon on the basin calmly watches. Static versus suspended objects make control over time legible. Very spare plaza, no grand palace, no solar arc, no floating city, no godlike crown, no glowing aura. One figure with believable hand and a clear understated visual idea.

editorialCandidates.name: farol-entre-mundos-editorial
editorialCandidates.prompt: Landscape 3:2 introductory adventure illustration. A modest old stone lighthouse on a rugged coastal cliff, a small damaged footbridge leading toward its door. One patched cable and a simple external ceramic insulator hint that the lighthouse could be technical or magical without fixing the genre. Two tiny travelers stop to inspect the missing bridge plank. Low horizon and large quiet unprinted sky. Lighthouse proportions must be structurally believable. No floating island, no purple beam, no majestic sunset, no nebula, no impossibly huge architecture. The adventure hook is an actual obstacle the players can investigate.

A middle aged woman with short curly hair in a creased brown raincoat crouches next to a drain to inspect a small torn piece of blue cloth snagged on it, pointing with a gloved index finger; her colleague remains partially out of view inside the doorway, watching the street. No noir neon, rain reflections, glamorous detective pose, dramatic lighting, cinematic color grading, blurry dream details, smoothing, text, lettering, logos or watermarks. Anatomically correct hands and coherent objects.
